confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from SQL injection attempts to successful database exploitation, privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and anti-forensic log deletion, all originating from a single external IP.

attack_chain.description: Initial SQL injection attempt via web server using tautology ('1'='1').
Successful SQL injection (UNION SELECT) to extract user credentials.
Database service executes query to retrieve usernames and passwords following the injection.
Attacker uses compromised credentials to log in as 'user_admin' from external IP 45.33.32.156.
Attacker performs self-escalation from 'admin' to 'superuser' role.
Attacker exports the 'customers' table from the database.
Attacker exports the 'transactions' table from the database.
Attacker downloads a full database backup file.
Data exfiltration to an external domain 'data.evil-exfil.com'.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of Apache access logs to hide traces.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of PostgreSQL query logs.

gaps: Verification of whether 'user_admin' is a legitimate service account or a human user account.
Confirmation of the actual volume of data exfiltrated via the network connections in evt_s8_014 and evt_s8_015.
narrative: An external attacker successfully performed a SQL injection attack to compromise credentials, subsequently logging in as 'user_admin'. The attacker escalated privileges to 'superuser', exported sensitive customer and transaction data, exfiltrated a database backup to an external domain, and finally deleted system logs to cover their tracks.
